payload.title: Continue independent semantic diagnoses after an incomplete candidate
payload.description:
As an optimization operator, I want each selected score to receive its own semantic diagnosis when evidence and budget remain available, so that one inconclusive score cannot prevent unrelated candidates from reaching automatic optimization.

Out of scope: increasing the frozen semantic budget, bypassing evidence gates, automatically promoting versions, or continuing after an unknown provider outcome or authority failure.

Feature: Independent semantic diagnosis coverage

Scenario: An ordinary incomplete diagnosis does not stop its siblings
Given three exact targets are selected for semantic diagnosis
And the first target returns complete transport evidence but an inconclusive semantic result
When the portfolio run continues
Then the second and third targets are still diagnosed
And only the incomplete target remains ineligible for optimization

Scenario: A safety-critical semantic failure stops further spend
Given multiple targets remain
When a diagnosis reports budget exhaustion, an unknown provider outcome, or an authority-publication failure
Then later diagnoses are deferred with the exact structured reason
And no target with incomplete evidence becomes optimization-ready

Scenario: A resumed partial diagnosis completes remaining targets
Given a durable diagnosis milestone records completed or incomplete results for only part of its scheduled scope
When the same run resumes with unchanged evidence and budget
Then it diagnoses only the remaining exact targets
And preserves the already published diagnosis evidence
